answers.how: The fish is approximately 210 pixels long and moves about 176 pixels/s. Its length is 210 × 0.67 / 176 ≈ 0.80 m.
The fish's full vertical extent is approximately 97 pixels. Using the motion-derived scale gives 97 × 0.67 / 176 ≈ 0.37 m.
The fish moves straight left, so its displacement magnitude is 0.67 × (1.0 − 0.5) = 0.335 m.
